theorem lg_target (c : ℝ) : (fun x => Real.log (x * c)) =O[Filter.atTop] Real.log := by
  let f := fun x => Real.log (x * c)
  let g := Real.log
  let ε : ℝ := Real.log c
  have h_diff : ∀ x ∈ Filter.atTop, |f x - g x| ≤ ε := by
    intro x hx
    have h_pos : x * c > 0 := by simp [hx, mul_pos]
    rw [f, g]
    rw [Real.log_mul] at h_pos
    rw [Real.log_mul]
    simp only [Real.log_mul, Real.log_div]
    norm_num
  have h_bound : ε < ∞ := by norm_num
  apply BigO.def f g Filter.atTop h_diff h_bound
